title: Boxes by Swagify
purpose: Custom branded merchandise-box shopping experience with a Vue 2 storefront and a separate Laravel 8 ordering API.
stack: Vue 2, Vue Router, Vuex, Axios, BootstrapVue, Laravel 8, PHP, Sanctum
eyebrow: CUSTOM MERCHANDISE / TWO CODEBASES, ONE PRODUCT
subtitle: Build a merchandise box, explore the catalog and manage orders.
summary: Build-a-box and ready-made merchandise storefront with Vue shopping journeys and Laravel catalog, customization, account and order endpoints.
overview: The ZIP describes two companion repositories: a Vue 2 customer storefront and a Laravel 8 API for box catalogs, cart and custom logo pricing, customer accounts and orders. They represent one product rather than two distinct case studies. The real frontend/backend connection and live commerce outcomes were not independently tested.
focus: What differentiates this work is the customer-led box-building and logo-pricing workflow, not generic e-commerce alone.
